documents.label: MPPSC advertisement register
documents.observation: Mixed dated recruitment notices; initially blank table later loaded. Exam results and current exam dates do not establish open applications.

documents.label: Fisheries 11/2026 HTML details
documents.observation: HTML labels Start Date and End Date agree with online application range in original; attachment points to same cycle.

documents.label: Assistant Director Fisheries 11/2026 original
documents.appointmentSummary: 14 vacancies; gazetted Class II; temporary status explicitly printed, with two-year probation for selected candidates. Do not normalize to permanent.
documents.nationalitySummary: Printed page 4 invites Indian citizens and other candidate categories recognized under India's Constitution, without establishing their full definitions on reviewed pages. No blanket foreign-applicant permission or exclusion accepted.
documents.qualificationSummary: Printed pages 4–5 specify postgraduate fisheries/zoology and training conditions, plus five years specified fisheries work experience; complete alternatives require review. Required qualification by 16 August. Age 21–under 40 as at 1 January 2027 before Annexure 1 exceptions.
documents.residenceSummary: MP domicile controls specified reservation benefits; other-state applicants can use unreserved category. Other-state is not foreign-citizen permission.
documents.languageSummary: Hindi notice; no formal language level or required exam/interview medium established on sampled pages. Conditional written-exam scheme would be published separately.
documents.selectionSummary: Printed page 6: qualification-based shortlisting and interview; written examination if more than 500 eligible applicants, followed by interview. Admission/invitation does not establish final eligibility; appointing department handles appointment.

knownGaps: Exact original unretained; no amendment reconciliation or accepted current status.
Hindi interpretation and complete constitutional nationality routes await review.
Language requirement is unknown; notice language cannot supply it.
Other MP authorities and notices remain outside this sample; no collector permission inferred.

documents.label: PPSC Open Advertisement index
documents.observation: Explicit no-open-advertisements message; one point-in-time directory observation only, not every Punjab authority or approved source-health result.

documents.label: Four Senior Assistant posts by transfer announcement
documents.observation: Announcement led to usermanual.ashx?id=1; visual letter matches four Senior Assistant transfer posts.

documents.label: Senior Assistant transfer letter
documents.appointmentSummary: Four Senior Assistant posts filled by transfer from serving Senior Assistants in other Punjab government departments; one-year probation after transfer. Permanent tenure not independently established.
documents.eligibilitySummary: Page 1 asks for completed probation, satisfactory service record and no pending disciplinary/vigilance inquiry; service record forwarded within 21 days of issue. Not an unrestricted new-entry competition.
documents.languageSummary: Punjabi original; no proficiency certificate, framework level or language subject condition established on page 1.

knownGaps: Page 2 and complete transfer conditions not interpreted; translation awaits review.
No notice-wide nationality rule or formal Punjabi level accepted.
Explicit empty PPSC index does not mean no Punjab jobs; other authorities remain gaps.
Previous normal collector failures and access permission remain unresolved.
